title: 🛫 Explore KMVN Mt. Vernon Outland Airport in MSFS! 🌟
description:
Take flight from the heart of Illinois with the newly released KMVN Mt. Vernon Outland Airport for Microsoft Flight Simulator! 🛩️ This detailed add-on features the expansive 6,500 ft. runway, dynamic lighting, and realistic airport infrastructure. Experience the bustling atmosphere as you pilot the versatile Cessna 172 Skyhawk, navigating through the meticulously crafted runways and taxiways. Whether you’re embarking on a scenic tour of the Midwest or a cross-country journey, Mt. Vernon Outland Airport offers an immersive experience for all aviation enthusiasts. Don’t miss out on adding this iconic airport to your MSFS collection! ✈️✨

For a full overview of new airports and scenery enhancements added to the marketplace this week have a look at the video below:
